behavior: Review gift collection re-reads the verified envelope before opening the destination review. No proof, wallet request, journal reservation or financial submit occurs during review.

An unavailable/untrusted response retains the verified letter and entered destination for explicit retry.
A read taking longer than15seconds releases busy controls. An eventual losing response cannot open review or update state; underlying SDK read may finish in the background.
Navigation/disconnection invalidates the letter generation; late availability results are ignored.
Private plaintext remains in memory; capability remains absent from request URLs, local storage and scrubbed address bar.
Guest submission status describes submission instead of requesting a Sapient approval.
